verification.notes: Waterfall computed on the FACE-VALUE cap table — i.e. exactly what is recorded in the Cap Table tab of the upload, IGNORING the unrecorded SAFEs and warrant. The tool's job is to flag those gaps via the checklist; it does not auto-correct. The corrected post-reconciliation waterfall would be computed by the analyst after they enter the missing data.

tranche_allocations.description: All LPs paid; Seed not yet converted; marginal value to common only
Series B converted; everyone is common

expected_checklist_findings.summary: Option pool last-grant-date is older than the most recent funding round closing date.
expected_checklist_findings.detail: Granted-options last grant date is 2025-03-01. Series B closed 2026-03-15. Grants made before a new round usually pre-date a 409A refresh; confirm whether all post-Series-A grants have been issued at refreshed FMV.

expected_checklist_findings.summary: SAFE issued 2024-08-12 ($500K, $4.5M cap) is not represented as converted shares on the cap table tab.
expected_checklist_findings.detail: A SAFE with a valuation cap below the Series B price-per-share would convert into preferred shares (or shadow preferred) at closing. Conversion math: $500,000 / ($4,500,000 / total fully-diluted at conversion) shares. Confirm and add converted shares to the Series B class.

expected_checklist_findings.summary: SAFE issued 2024-09-04 ($500K, $4.5M cap) is not represented as converted shares on the cap table tab.
expected_checklist_findings.detail: Same as G02-02a. Two SAFEs in this position; combined unrecorded dilution is non-trivial.

expected_checklist_findings.summary: 50,000-share common warrant (Northstar Marketing Pte) referenced in side letter but not on cap table tab.
expected_checklist_findings.detail: Vendor warrants struck at low prices add to fully-diluted share count and affect breakpoints. Add to cap table or confirm warrant has not been exercised and is excluded by policy.

expected_checklist_findings.summary: MFN side letter exists for a Series B strategic investor but no specific MFN terms have been entered.
expected_checklist_findings.detail: MFN can affect future-round dilution and conversion terms. Capture the trigger and the scope of "more favorable terms" the MFN applies to.

expected_checklist_findings.summary: Anti-dilution variant for Series A Preferred is blank.
expected_checklist_findings.detail: Anti-dilution variant materially affects share count under any future down-round scenario. Confirm broad-based weighted-average, narrow-based weighted-average, or full ratchet from charter.
